prompt: WebGPU sampling depth stencil texture non-depth channels without texture-component-swizzle
answer:
Without `texture-component-swizzle`, there is no portable way to sample the non-depth components of a depth/stencil texture as defined values. For a regular `texture_2d` binding, the result is `(V, X, X, X)`, where `V` is the depth or stencil value and the other components are implementation-defined ([proposal](https://github.com/gpuweb/gpuweb/blob/main/proposals/texture-component-swizzle.md)).

Portable options are:

- Bind the depth aspect as `texture_depth` and sample its single `f32` depth value; this type does not return non-depth components ([CTS discussion](https://github.com/gpuweb/cts/pull/4427)).
- For stencil, bind a stencil-aspect view separately as a `uint` binding ([issue #1230](https://github.com/gpuweb/gpuweb/issues/1230)).
- If you need a predictable four-component value, construct it in the shader from the sampled scalar, rather than reading `.g`, `.b`, or `.a`.

The `(V, 0, 0, 1)` behavior is guaranteed only when the `texture-component-swizzle` feature is enabled; implementations are merely encouraged to provide it otherwise.
